requires.note: Complete converted Warcraft I data tree
PAX video pack generated from extracted PC movie files

instructions: HOST COMPUTER REQUIRED: war1tool is not an ESP32-P4 program. On Linux, use your own Warcraft I PC ISO and a local Wargus/war1gus source checkout. Install CMake, a C++ compiler, cdrtools (isoinfo), FFmpeg/ffprobe, Python 3, and Pillow. Run: python3 ~/code/pax/pax-recipe/tools/prepare_war1gus_iso.py --iso /path/to/warcraft.iso --source /path/to/war1gus --output /path/to/new-war1gus-data --soundfont /path/to/your.sf2. This builds war1tool, extracts /DATA/*.WAR, converts the assets and movie pack, then verifies the output. Copy the generated tree contents to /sd/roms/war1gus/ and keep media/menu.paxmenu at that exact path. Omit --soundfont to skip OGG music rendering; supplying one also requires FluidSynth. The recipe PAX only creates SD folders and shows these instructions; it does not run war1tool. Game assets stay private and are not uploaded. The PAX game build is not yet verified as playable.
